senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כָּרָה) [to bore, break through,] to well forth.

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 104b:2">Erub. 104ᵇ</cite> (expl. <he>בור הקר</he>, v. <cite ref="E00803"><he>הָקֵר</he></cite>) <he>בור שהֵקֵרוּ עליה דברים והתירוה</he> (Or Zar. Erub. 216 <he>הֵקֵירוּ</he>) a well over which they (the scholars) caused words (arguments) to burst forth, and which they finally permitted; <cite ref="Eruvin 104b:2">ib.</cite> <he>שהקרו דברים עליה</he>.
